message.content:
A vertical rectangular editorial cover features a red border on the left. At the top, black text reads "PETINGGI DEMOKRAT DI SKK MIGAS". Below this, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large, red, bold capital letters. Underneath "TEMPO" is "24 FEBRUARI-2 MARET 2014".

On the left, large black text reads "ASTAGA! LABEL HALAL". Below this, smaller black text states: "Petinggi Majelis Ulama Indonesia ditengarai memperdagangkan label halal. Tempo melacak hingga Australia dan Belgia."

A large cylindrical metal can dominates the right side. It has a red and white label. The top of the can shows a silver metallic pull-tab lid. The word "Halal" is written in white cursive script on the red portion. Below it, an oval frame contains an illustration of a pinkish-brown pig standing and facing right. Below the pig, a red banner reads "DIJAMIN". Below this is a green circular seal with a white "حلال" and "HALAL" logo, surrounded by "MAJELIS ULAMA INDONESIA".

The bottom left includes "RP 33.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and a barcode with numbers "00052" and "9 770126 427302".
